app that lacks it. Every executor the driver creates from that template is born gated. The Apache operator plays no
part in scaling at all - it only needs to honour spec.suspend, which controller.go:200 sets for the initial

that into one reconcile. And the event carries no count: it is purely a trigger to go and look.
